title: Falnama Scenario Index Card
description: An immutable, timestamped, content-hashed mapping from a prediction-market question to its plausible downstream asset implications. Created BEFORE any recommendation and never edited in place, so a later trade can always be traced to a prior, frozen hypothesis. JSON has no comments, so field meanings live in 'description'.

card_id.description: Stable identifier, derived from the market key plus the creation timestamp.

card_version.description: e.g. 'v1' for a live card or 'v1-mock' for a deterministic mock card.

card_hash.description: SHA-256 over the card with this field blanked. Detects any later tampering.

do_not_revise.description: Always true. Cards are immutable; regeneration writes a NEW card.

created_time_utc.description: When the card was created. The recommender compares this to an anomaly's trigger time to reject ex-post cards.

mock_mode.description: True if produced by the deterministic mock generator rather than the live LLM.

source.description: Provenance: which market this card is about.

source_market_file.description: The selected-markets file this market came from.

prediction_window.description: Horizon the card reasons over, e.g. '12h'.

predictions.description: One or more asset implications of the market event.

tradable_instrument_name.description: The concrete instrument, e.g. 'United States Oil Fund'.

expected_direction.description: Direction of the expected move in the asset.

expected_return_12h_bps.description: Expected return over the prediction window, in basis points (100 bps = 1%). Sign matches direction.

confidence.description: Subjective probability the mapping is correct, 0..1.

confidence_interval_bps.description: [low, high] plausible range for the expected return, in bps.

trade_eligibility.description: Whether the expected move clears the configured threshold to be actionable on paper.

time_plan.description: What to re-check at each checkpoint after the signal — the monitoring plan.

reasoning.description: Why this market move implies this asset move.

realized_outcome.description: Optional: how the market actually resolved, filled in later for evaluation.

evidence_used.description: The inputs the analysis relied on (market metadata, sensitivity mapping, analogues, public info to check).

uncertainty_notes.description: Caveats. Mock cards say so explicitly here.

llm_justification.description: The reasoning record. 'why_not_ex_post' states how immutability + hashing prevent retrofitting a story to a move.
